title: Paystride Save Interest Rate Schedule
content:
Paystride Save accounts are held at Harborline Bank, N.A. and pay interest at the annual percentage yields set for each tier below. Each tier pays its annual percentage yield on the balance up to that tier's APY balance cap, and a lower annual percentage yield on the part of the balance above the cap.

## Yield by tier

| Tier | Annual percentage yield up to the cap | APY balance cap | Annual percentage yield above the cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | 0.5% | $1000.00 | 0.25% |
| Paystride Save Builder | 1.25% | $2500.00 | 0.5% |
| Paystride Save Boost | 2.0% | $5000.00 | 0.75% |
| Paystride Save Growth | 2.75% | $10000.00 | 1.0% |
| Paystride Save Premier | 3.3% | $15000.00 | 1.25% |
| Paystride Save Elite | 3.8% | $25000.00 | 1.5% |

## Accrual, crediting and reporting terms

| Term | Starter | Builder | Boost | Growth | Premier | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Balance on which interest accrues | end-of-day balance, accrued daily | end-of-day balance, accrued daily | end-of-day balance, accrued daily | end-of-day balance, accrued daily | end-of-day balance, accrued daily | end-of-day balance, accrued daily |
| Days in the year used to convert the yield to a daily rate | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| How often accrued interest is credited | monthly, on the last calendar day | monthly, on the last calendar day | monthly, on the last calendar day | monthly, on the last calendar day | monthly, on the last calendar day | monthly, on the last calendar day |
| Smallest interest credit (less accrues to the next month) | $0.01 | $0.01 | $0.01 | $0.01 | $0.01 | $0.01 |
| Interest accrued but not credited is forfeited when the account closes mid-month | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Interest keeps accruing while the account is frozen | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Interest credited in a calendar year at or above which a Form 1099-INT is issued | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The APY balance cap marks where the two yields meet: the yield in the first table's second column is paid on the balance up to the cap, and the yield in the fourth column only on the part of the balance above it.
2. Mid-month forfeiture differs by tier: on Paystride Save Starter, Builder and Boost, interest accrued but not yet credited is forfeited when the account closes mid-month; on Paystride Save Growth, Premier and Elite the schedule sets no such forfeiture.
3. The Form 1099-INT threshold is read against interest credited in the calendar year, and includes the threshold amount itself: a year's credited interest of exactly $10.00 is at the threshold.
